citations.title: Privacy Policy
excerpts: In Short: We only process your personal information when we believe it is necessary and we have a valid legal reason (i.e., legal basis) to do so under applicable law, like with your consent, to comply with laws, to provide you with services to enter into or fulfill our contractual obligations, to protect your rights, or to fulfill our legitimate business interests.
If you are located in the EU or UK, this section applies to you.

The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and UK GDPR require us to explain the valid legal bases we rely on in order to process your personal information. As such, we may rely on the following legal bases to process your personal information:

Consent. We may process your information if you have given us permission (i.e., consent) to use your personal information for a specific purpose. You can withdraw your consent at any time. Click here to learn more.

Performance of a Contract. We may process your personal information when we believe it is necessary to fulfill our contractual obligations to you, including providing our Services or at your request prior to entering into a contract with you.
We utilize information from Google APIs for specific purposes, which include:
Creating Candidate Profiles: We gather data from Google APIs to assist in the creation of candidate profiles. This data is utilized solely for enhancing our candidate profiling processes.

Obtaining Resume Data: We use Google APIs to collect resume data. The resumes are processed to extract significant details and to remove personal identifiers. This anonymized information is then sent to our AI tools to refine and enhance candidate profile creation.

Important Note: We explicitly affirm that any information obtained from Google APIs is not used to develop, improve, or train generalized AI or Machine Learning models. The data is strictly used for the above-mentioned purposes and remains anonymized throughout our processes.
We are committed to ensuring the privacy and security of the information we collect and utilize. Our practices comply with all relevant data protection regulations and standards.

basis.reasoning: The privacy page names GDPR and says the company practices comply with relevant data protection regulations and standards; GDPR is the only one of the requested named frameworks supported here.
